notNamed: The owner rules HR-C5, HR-C7 and HR-C9, and the WP5-SVC-1 fix, have no fix mutation named in the proof (CATCHERS / FIX_CATCHERS) or the book. When one is implemented, its fix mutation is derived from the implementing commit and named in FIX_CATCHERS and here in the same batch (plan section 1.4); no catcher is guessed now. HR-C6 (L35, L36, X-FINANCE-1) is CERT-5's.
note: Fields as in wp5-mutations.supply.json; pending entries carry loci (HEAD text the fix will change) instead of from / to. Judged by wp5-mutation-evidence.js --lists=fix against the post-fix baseline. Run one id per invocation, quoted and with a trailing comma ("--only=M-AVL,") and always with --lists=<key>: mutate-multi.js matches a value without a comma as a PREFIX (M-AVL would also run M-AVLa and M-AVLb; M-PCL0 also M-PCL0i and M-PCL0k; M-PCLg also M-PCLga and M-PCLgb), PowerShell drops an unquoted trailing comma, and ids such as M1 or G1 repeat across other lists.
